name: Sweet Enchantments
source:
Desserts are just the icing on the cake when you stumble upon a magical cafe! But when the staff discovers you’re a human, you find yourself forced to work alongside them to keep your identity hidden! When all your coworkers are magicians, it’s not hard to fall under their spell...

[From [url=https://lovestruckvoltage.tumblr.com/post/178953165308/sweet-enchantments-out-now-desserts-are]Voltage Lovestruck blog[/url]]
